scripts.install: npm install --prefix frontend && pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "cross-env DATA_PATH=./data OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434 python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --log-level debug" "cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cross-env DATA_PATH=./data OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434 python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --log-level debug
scripts.start:ollama:docker: docker start ollama-local || docker run -d --name ollama-local -p 127.0.0.1:11434:11434 -v ollama:/root/.ollama ollama/ollama:latest
